## Account List Detail

### list

`accountListDetail.list`

QuickBooks Query a report

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.quickbooks.api.accountListDetail.list({"realmId":"12345678","params":{}});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `realmId` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `params` | `object` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="params full type">

```ts
{
  account_type?: string,
  end_date?: string,
  start_moddate?: string,
  sort_by?: string,
  sort_order?: string,
  moddate_macro?: string,
  end_moddate?: string,
  account_status?: string,
  createdate_macro?: string,
  start_date?: string,
  columns?: string
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `Header` | `object` | No | — |
| `Rows` | `object` | No | — |
| `Columns` | `object` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Header full type">

```ts
{
  Customer?: string,
  ReportName?: string,
  Vendor?: string,
  Option?: {
    Name?: string,
    Value?: string
  }[],
  Item?: string,
  Employee?: string,
  ReportBasis?: Accrual | Cash,
  StartPeriod?: string,
  Class?: string,
  Currency?: string,
  EndPeriod?: string,
  Time?: string,
  Department?: string,
  SummarizeColumnsBy?: Total | Year | Quarter | FiscalYear | FiscalQuarter | Month | Week | Days | Customers | Vendors | Employees | Departments | Classes | ProductsAndServices
}
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Rows full type">

```ts
{
  Row?: {
    type?: Section | Data,
    group?: string,
    ColData?: {
      id?: string,
      value?: string,
      href?: string
    }[],
    Summary?: (recursive),
    Rows?: {
      Row?: (recursive)[]
    },
    Header?: (recursive)
  }[]
}
```
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Columns full type">

```ts
{
  Column?: {
    ColType?: Account | Money | Rate | Customer | Vendor | Employee | ProductsAndService | Department | Class | String,
    ColTitle?: string
  }[]
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Accounts

### create

`accounts.create`

Create a QuickBooks account in the company chart of accounts

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.quickbooks.api.accounts.create({"realmId":"12345678","name":"Operating Checking","accountType":"Bank"});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `realmId` | `string` | Yes | QuickBooks company realm ID returned in Intuit’s OAuth redirect |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `accountType` | `Bank \| Accounts Receivable \| Other Current Asset \| Fixed Asset \| Other Asset \| Accounts Payable \| Credit Card \| Other Current Liability \| Long Term Liability \| Equity \| Income \| Cost of Goods Sold \| Expense \| Other Income \| Other Expense` | No | — |
| `accountSubType` | `string` | No | — |
| `acctNum` | `string` | No | — |
| `taxCodeRef` | `object` | No | — |

POST /v3/company/&#123;realmId&#125;/account. Name must be unique, at most 100 characters, and cannot contain a double quote or colon. Supply accountType or accountSubType. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/api/accounting/all-entities/account

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="taxCodeRef full type">

```ts
{
  name?: string,
  type?: string,
  value: string
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `Account` | `object` | Yes | — |
| `time` | `string` | Yes | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Account full type">

```ts
{
  Id: string,
  SyncToken: string,
  MetaData?: {
    CreatedByRef?: {
      name?: string,
      type?: string,
      value: string
    },
    CreateTime?: string,
    LastModifiedByRef?: {
      name?: string,
      type?: string,
      value: string
    },
    LastUpdatedTime?: string,
    LastChangedInQB?: string,
    Synchronized?: boolean
  },
  Name: string,
  SubAccount?: boolean,
  ParentRef?: {
    name?: string,
    type?: string,
    value: string
  },
  Description?: string,
  FullyQualifiedName?: string,
  AccountAlias?: string,
  TxnLocationType?: string,
  Active?: boolean,
  Classification?: Asset | Equity | Expense | Liability | Revenue,
  AccountType?: Bank | Accounts Receivable | Other Current Asset | Fixed Asset | Other Asset | Accounts Payable | Credit Card | Other Current Liability | Long Term Liability | Equity | Income | Cost of Goods Sold | Expense | Other Income | Other Expense,
  AccountSubType?: string,
  AccountPurposes?: {
    name?: string,
    type?: string,
    value: string
  }[],
  AcctNum?: string,
  AcctNumExtn?: string,
  BankNum?: string,
  OpeningBalance?: number,
  OpeningBalanceDate?: string,
  CurrentBalance?: number,
  CurrentBalanceWithSubAccounts?: number,
  CurrencyRef?: {
    name?: string,
    type?: string,
    value: string
  },
  TaxAccount?: boolean,
  TaxCodeRef?: {
    name?: string,
    type?: string,
    value: string
  },
  OnlineBankingEnabled?: boolean,
  FIName?: string,
  JournalCodeRef?: {
    name?: string,
    type?: string,
    value: string
  },

  domain?: QBO,
  sparse?: boolean
}
```

### get

`accounts.get`

Read one account by its QuickBooks account ID

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.quickbooks.api.accounts.get({"realmId":"12345678","accountId":"35"});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `realmId` | `string` | Yes | QuickBooks company realm ID returned in Intuit’s OAuth redirect |
| `accountId` | `string` | Yes | — |

GET /v3/company/&#123;realmId&#125;/account/&#123;accountId&#125;. Account IDs are strings. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/api/accounting/all-entities/account

### list

`accounts.list`

List accounts with QuickBooks query pagination

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.quickbooks.api.accounts.list({"realmId":"12345678","startPosition":1,"maxResults":50});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `realmId` | `string` | Yes | QuickBooks company realm ID returned in Intuit’s OAuth redirect |
| `startPosition` | `number` | No | — |
| `maxResults` | `number` | No | — |

GET /v3/company/&#123;realmId&#125;/query with SELECT * FROM Account. Pagination uses STARTPOSITION and MAXRESULTS (1–1000; default 100). Source: https://static.developer.intuit.com/output_html/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/data-queries.html



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `QueryResponse` | `object` | Yes | — |
| `time` | `string` | Yes | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="QueryResponse full type">

```ts
{
  startPosition?: number,
  maxResults?: number,
  totalCount?: number,
  Account?: {
    Id: string,

      CreatedByRef?: {
        name?: string,
        type?: string,
        value: string
      },

    AccountSubType?: string,
    AccountPurposes?: {
      name?: string,
```

### update

`accounts.update`

QuickBooks Full update an account

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.quickbooks.api.accounts.update({"realmId":"12345678","body":{"Id":"35","Name":"sample","SyncToken":"0"}});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `realmId` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `body` | `object` | Yes | — |

This is Intuit's full update operation, not a patch. Include the latest Id and SyncToken and every writable field that should be preserved; writable fields omitted from the request are set to null. Source: https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/api/accounting/all-entities/account

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="body full type">

```ts
{
  SyncToken: string,
  SubAccount?: boolean,
  Classification?: string,
  FullyQualifiedName?: string,
  AccountType?: Bank | Accounts Receivable | Other Current Asset | Fixed Asset | Other Asset | Accounts Payable | Credit Card | Other Current Liability | Long Term Liability | Equity | Income | Cost of Goods Sold | Expense | Other Income | Other Expense | Non-Posting,
  CurrencyRef?: {
    name?: string,
    value: string
  },
  CurrentBalanceWithSubAccounts?: number,
  AcctNum?: string,
  TaxCodeRef?: {
    name?: string,
    value: string
  },
  ParentRef?: {
    name?: string,
    value: string
  },
  AccountSubType?: string,
  CurrentBalance?: number,
  Description?: string,
  Active?: boolean,
  MetaData?: {
    CreateTime?: string,
    LastUpdatedTime?: string
  },
  Id: string,
  Name?: string
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `Account` | `object` | Yes | — |
| `time` | `string` | Yes | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Account full type">

```ts
{
  SyncToken?: string,
  SubAccount?: boolean,
  Classification?: string,
  FullyQualifiedName?: string,
  AccountType?: Bank | Accounts Receivable | Other Current Asset | Fixed Asset | Other Asset | Accounts Payable | Credit Card | Other Current Liability | Long Term Liability | Equity | Income | Cost of Goods Sold | Expense | Other Income | Other Expense | Non-Posting,
  CurrencyRef?: {
    name?: string,
    value: string
  },
  CurrentBalanceWithSubAccounts?: number,
  AcctNum?: string,
  TaxCodeRef?: {
    name?: string,
    value: string
  },
  ParentRef?: {
    name?: string,
    value: string
  },
  AccountSubType?: string,
  CurrentBalance?: number,
  Description?: string,
  Active?: boolean,
  MetaData?: {
    CreateTime?: string,
    LastUpdatedTime?: string
  },

  Name: string
}
```

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.quickbooks.api.attachable.create({"realmId":"12345678","body":{}});
```

**Input**

|------|------|----------|-------------|

| `body` | `object` | Yes | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="body full type">

```ts
{
  Note?: string,
  AttachableRef?: {
    IncludeOnSend?: boolean,
    LineInfo?: string,
    NoRefOnly?: boolean,
    CustomField?: {
      DefinitionId: string,
      StringValue?: string,
      Type?: StringType | BooleanType | NumberType | DateType,
      Name?: string
    }[],
    Inactive?: boolean,
    EntityRef?: {
      type?: string,
      value: string,
      name?: string
    }
  }[],
  FileName?: string
}
```

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

## Change Data Capture

### changes

`changeDataCapture.changes`

List supported QuickBooks entities changed since a recent timestamp

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.quickbooks.api.changeDataCapture.changes({"realmId":"12345678","entities":["Customer"],"changedSince":"2026-11-18T12:00:00Z"});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `realmId` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `entities` | `(Account \| Attachable \| Bill \| BillPayment \| Budget \| ChangeOrder \| Class \| CompanyCurrency \| CompanyInfo \| CreditCardPayment \| CreditMemo \| Customer \| CustomerType \| Department \| Deposit \| Employee \| Estimate \| Exchangerate \| InventoryAdjustment \| Invoice \| Item \| JournalEntry \| Payment \| PaymentMethod \| Preferences \| Purchase \| PurchaseOrder \| RecurringTransaction \| RefundReceipt \| ReimburseCharge \| SalesReceipt \| TaxClassification \| TaxPayment \| TaxService \| Term \| Transfer \| Vendor \| VendorCredit)[]` | Yes | — |
| `changedSince` | `string` | Yes | — |

changedSince must be within the previous 30 days. JournalCode, TaxAgency, TimeActivity, TaxCode, and TaxRate are not supported. Source: https://static.developer.intuit.com/output_html/qbo/docs/learn/explore-the-quickbooks-online-api/change-data-capture.html



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `CDCResponse` | `object[]` | Yes | — |
| `time` | `string` | Yes | — |

### update

`exchangerate.update`

QuickBooks Update an exchangerate

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.quickbooks.api.exchangerate.update({"realmId":"12345678","body":{"SyncToken":"0","SourceCurrencyCode":"EUR","Rate":1.08,"AsOfDate":"2026-11-18"}});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `realmId` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `body` | `object` | Yes | — |

```ts
  }[],
```

### deleteCategory

`item.deleteCategory`

QuickBooks Delete a category (categories cannot be made inactive)

**Risk:** `destructive`

```ts
await corsair.quickbooks.api.item.deleteCategory({"realmId":"12345678","body":{"Id":"35","SyncToken":"0"}});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `realmId` | `string` | Yes | — |
| `body` | `object` | Yes | — |

POST /v3/company/&#123;realmId&#125;/item?operation=delete with the category's Id and SyncToken. Categories can't be made inactive (QuickBooks answers fault 1020 to Active=false); other item types can't be deleted, only made inactive with item.update.

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="body full type">

```ts
{
  Id: string,
  SyncToken: string
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `Item` | `object` | Yes | — |
| `time` | `string` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Item full type">

```ts
{
  status: Deleted,
  Id: string,
  domain?: QBO
}
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
